body.estimand_functional: \(\widehat\theta_N=(NT_N)^{-1}\int_0^{T_N}\{K_{0,N}(t)-K_{1,N}(t)\}\,dt,\quad \sqrt{NT_N}(\widehat\theta_N-\theta_N)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,V);\quad \widetilde\theta_N=\vartheta_N(\widehat p;M_N),\quad \sqrt{NT_N}(\widetilde\theta_N-\theta_N)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,Q),\quad \sqrt{NT_N}(\widehat\theta_N-\widetilde\theta_N)\Rightarrow\mathcal N(0,W)\), with no upper restriction on \(T_N/N\) for the exact centers.

sampling_model.design: Two equal-sized arms are randomized before monitoring; at every array index each arm contains \(N\) participants, the treatment arm receives implemented capacity \(M_N=\lceil Na+\gamma\sqrt N\rceil\), and the aggregate arm processes evolve independently in stationarity.
sampling_model.units: Each arm contains \(N\) finite-source participants; dependence among treatment participants is induced by shared service capacity.
sampling_model.treatment: Control participants recover naturally at rate \(\tau\); treated participants additionally recover through service at aggregate rate \(\nu\min\{K_{1,N},M_N\}\).
sampling_model.overlap: Randomization identifies the implemented arm contrast; the model-based time-series law conditions on the realized equal arm sizes and capacity.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The rates \((\lambda,\tau,\nu)\) are estimated from marked transition counts divided by at-risk occupation exposures.  Fitted inference evaluates the exact finite-chain stationary product law at those estimated rates while holding the observed capacity fixed; the diffusion expression is reported only through its separate rate-restricted corollary.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The paper allows distinct fixed arm populations and capacity, proves a fixed-system large-duration occupation limit, and separately gives a many-system fluid limit.
A piecewise Ornstein--Uhlenbeck diffusion approximates a stationary normalized system size in its many-server model.
Prelimit Poisson equations can shift Stein-factor analysis from diffusion derivatives to finite differences for static steady-state approximation.
Mixing triangular arrays admit quantitative functional central limit bounds under stated moment and mixing conditions.
For a fixed countable-state continuous-time Markov chain, Poisson martingales and likelihood-ratio scores admit joint limit theory.
Estimating nuisance parameters by score equations can reduce oracle sandwich variance by a score-projection term in regular estimating-equation models.
Square-root staffing is asymptotically optimal for an open call center under staffing and delay costs.
Queue-informed estimators and confidence intervals improve inference for stochastic-congestion experiments in an open single-server system.
Double machine learning yields efficient inference under conditional shared-state interference.

body.tldr: For equal-arm stationary homogeneous marked-history service experiments, the paper derives a compact-uniform joint occupation-and-rate-score Gaussian law from exact finite-chain Poisson martingales.  Evaluating the exact stationary product law at the estimated rates while holding implemented capacity fixed yields fitted-center variance \(Q=A^{\mathsf T}\Gamma A\), residual variance \(W=V-Q\), and uniformly valid Wald coverage for arbitrary joint divergence of \(N\) and \(T_N\).  The proved kink residual makes the diffusion center an \(O(N^{-1})\)-accurate corollary under \(T_N=o(N)\).  A generic branch-and-bound theorem gives finite certificate semantics conditional on supplied sound oracle receipts; constructing that oracle from the piecewise-Gaussian formulas with an explicit certified modulus remains open.

project_justification.gap: The operational-dosage anchor permits distinct fixed arm populations and capacity and gives separate fixed-system occupation and many-system fluid results.  It does not furnish the joint critical array law, marked-rate covariance, or exact fixed-capacity plug-in inference proved here for the narrower equal-arm stationary homogeneous subclass.  For capacity choice, neither the anchor nor the present frozen core supplies a validated rational oracle for the piecewise-Gaussian Poisson-energy objective.
project_justification.niche: The finite-source birth--death product law makes the implemented finite-system effect exactly computable at candidate rates, while critical capacity creates a piecewise-diffusion score correction and a nontrivial kink residual.  The design calculation separates generic, checkable branch-and-bound logic from the model-specific interval evaluation problem.
project_justification.fill: The paper proves stationary diffusion and Poisson-energy limits, a primitive martingale joint central limit law, the exact product-law fitted-center Wald theorem without a horizon upper bound, the uniform kink residual, and the diffusion corollary under \(T_N=o(N)\).  It also proves oracle-conditional rational branch-and-bound semantics and conditional finite-system regret, while isolating sound piecewise-Gaussian oracle construction as an unresolved model-specific obligation.

body.related_work: Boutilier, Jonasson, Li, and Yoeli allow distinct fixed arm populations and service capacity and establish separate fixed-system occupation and many-system fluid results.  This paper studies the narrower equal-arm stationary compact homogeneous marked-history critical subclass and derives a joint population-duration limit there; it does not claim that positive results transfer upward to the broader anchor class.  Braverman and Dai and Braverman inform the piecewise-diffusion and prelimit-Poisson residual methods.  Hafouta informs uniform triangular-array reasoning, although the exact martingale proof here needs no upper horizon exponent.  Wang and Plechac and Lok inform score--Poisson covariance and projection interpretations; the model-specific fixed-capacity derivative and exact product-law elbow are derived here.  Borst, Mandelbaum, and Reiman motivate square-root staffing.  Generic interval reasoning supports the conditional certificate theorem, but it does not supply the missing sound rational oracle, explicit Gaussian-energy modulus, or evaluation witnesses.  Li, Johari, Kuang, and Wager and Hays and Raghavan concern different congestion or interference models.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The floating-point witness at \((\lambda,\tau,\nu,\gamma)=(1,1,1,0)\) remains diagnostic rather than a certified theorem output.  The kink residual is proved uniformly, including kink-crossing jumps and ceiling phases, and \(K_{\mathrm{res}}\) is a proved finite constant.  The unresolved computational step is to turn the supplied rational input name and piecewise-Gaussian Poisson-energy formulas into sound rational interval receipts with an explicit uniform modulus and finite checkable witnesses.  The branch-and-bound and regret results are conditional on those receipts.  Marked recovery causes, stationary initialization, independent equal-sized arms, homogeneous compactly positive rates, and a bounded critical staffing window remain substantive restrictions.
body.honest_scope: Exact finite-chain fitted centering and empirical inference require only \(N,T_N\to\infty\); no upper relation between duration and enrollment is imposed.  The diffusion fitted center differs by \(O_{\mathbb P}(N^{-1})\), so the proved route gives its Wald law under \(T_N/N\to0\).  The paper does not claim results for the anchor's unequal-arm class, unmarked histories, common shocks, arbitrary initialization, heterogeneous rates, vanishing-rate boundaries, post-assignment randomization inference, or clinical cure effects.  Capacity certification and finite-system regret are oracle-relative; construction of the required model-specific sound oracle remains open.
body.interpretation: The exact fitted interval targets the implemented stationary operational effect, not a diffusion estimand: at the true rates the product-law map equals \(\theta_N\) exactly.  Same-path rate fitting projects the empirical occupation fluctuation onto the marked rate scores, producing fitted-center variance \(Q\) and empirical-minus-fitted variance \(W=V-Q\).  The diffusion center is computationally simpler but inherits the additional \(T_N=o(N)\) condition from its proved \(O(N^{-1})\) approximation error.  If a sound objective oracle is supplied, the generic certificate and regret theorems validate its returned offset; absent that oracle, the paper makes no machine-checkable model-specific staffing recommendation.
